bugs.name: Protected tag validation exposes an untranslated field identifier
bugs.summary: An invalid protected-tag glob displays form.NamePattern instead of a readable field name.
bugs.expected: Reject the invalid pattern with a readable Tag pattern validation message.
bugs.actual: The banner reads “form.NamePattern glob pattern is invalid: unexpected end of input.”
reproSteps: As a repository administrator, open Settings > Tags in a disposable repository.
Enter [ in Tag pattern and select Add rule.
Read the validation banner; its field name is form.NamePattern.

bugs.name: Invalid branch-protection pattern returns HTTP 500 and is saved anyway
bugs.summary: Saving an invalid glob in a branch-protection rule crashes the request, but the invalid rule still persists in the repository's settings.
bugs.expected: Reject malformed branch patterns with a validation message and leave the rule list unchanged.
bugs.actual: Saving [bad returns a 500 Internal server error page with 'PANIC: unexpected end of input'. Returning to Branches settings shows [bad persisted. Repeating with [another produces the same 500 and another saved invalid rule.
reproSteps: Sign in as the repository owner and open an initialized repository's Settings > Branches (tested on /momentic-admin/bash-settings-renamed/settings/branches).
Set Protected branch name pattern to [bad, leaving other settings at defaults.
Return to Settings > Branches and observe the invalid [bad rule in the list.

bugs.name: Units Overview package-privacy warning overflows and is clipped at narrow viewport widths
bugs.summary: At 375px wide, the package-privacy warning on a fresh private repository’s Units Overview page is visibly cut off; revealing its trailing text requires horizontal scrolling that shifts the settings content offscreen.
bugs.expected: The package-privacy warning should remain readable within the 375px viewport or wrap without requiring horizontal scrolling that moves the rest of the settings page out of view.
bugs.actual: The warning is cut off at the right edge. Scrolling horizontally reveals its trailing copy, including that the owner is public, only while shifting the Overview card and other settings content left so their left sides are clipped. Returning to the default horizontal position restores the cutoff; it remained after refresh and while waiting.
reproSteps: In a fresh browser session, load the authorized saved admin session for the momentic-admin account; do not change authentication details.
Navigate to /momentic-admin/mo-settings-units-overview/settings/units. This supplied repository was used only to reach the momentic-admin owner page and was left read-only.
Open the momentic-admin owner page, then the main navigation menu > Create > New repository.
Create a new repository owned by momentic-admin named mo-settings-units-overview-375, leave Make repository private checked, and leave Initialize repository unchecked.

Set the viewport to 375 × 844 CSS pixels. In the new repository, open the repository overflow menu > Settings, expand Units, and open Overview. The resulting page URL is /momentic-admin/mo-settings-units-overview-375/settings/units.
Scroll vertically until the Overview card and package-linking warning are visible. Observe that the warning text is cut off at the right viewport edge.
Scroll horizontally to the right. Observe that the trailing warning text becomes visible while the left side of the settings content is clipped; scroll back left and observe the warning cutoff again.
Refresh and wait with the warning visible. The cutoff remains.

matchingGuidance.acceptanceScope: Accepted as a valid reference by user instruction; source prerequisites and remaining evidence gaps are retained below.
prerequisites: 375px viewport, private repo whose owner is public, long localized warning.
